1st October - Paris - FRANCE v G.BRITAIN v FINLAND Triple Jump 1.E.Battista (France) 51'7¼" 2.F.Alsop (GB) 51'4½" 3.K.Helminen (Fin) 50'11" 5.D.Boosey (GB/BEL) 49'5¾"

On May 20th at San Jose in California he had Triple-Jumped 51'8½ only 2½" behind his own Club Record and with National Record holder Fred Alsop not as fit as he has been, Derek could possibl; have taken his first AAA title.
Britain has picked her strongest possible team for the match and Derek partners the man who led them all for four rounds in the Tokyo Olympics---Fred Alsop.

He partners Fred Alsop of Havering A.C., who was 4th in Tokyo in 1964. All Belgravians will be with him in spirit when he takes his turn on that very lonely Tartan strip in Mexico City.Another to tread that important run-up will be our second claim member from Q.P.H.
